title: Export the seed snapshot off serve's event loop
goal: A large seed no longer blocks the active main's event loop while it serialises and signs the snapshot
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: Serve exports, serialises and signs a seed snapshot in a worker thread (or streams it in chunks), so lease renewals and Kaji requests are served during a seed of a large store (a regression with a store of many rows measures the event-loop delay)
Owner agreed 2026-11-24 to add this step, after B-124
validation: Directed regression measuring event-loop delay during a seed; final required CI
escalation: Found by the #725 design review on 2026-11-24 (should-fix 6, the part left after the lock was shortened); owner agreed 2026-11-24 to add it to the adopted plan, after B-124
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 from F-016-T20 (1.5 h). Implemented 2026-11-26 in exportSeedSnapshotAsync (worker thread) with 25,000-row event-loop delay, concurrent lease/Kaji and mid-export fencing regression; remaining: CI.
